⚙️ SAKSHI DECISION GATEWAY — The Core Evidence Engine
Every loan decision passes through here · Sits between LSP model and lender approval · Flask REST API · Python 3.11
• Read ONNX file from disk into bytes
This catches silent model swaps between audits
Proves WHICH input was scored, not the values
Model is verified BEFORE this runs (Step ②)
• Build JSON record (no shap_values in signed payload):
• Append full record to JSONL log
• Each entry: batch_id, timestamp, leaves[], root
• Altering any leaf → root mismatch detected
• Input visibility: HASHED (Poseidon commitment + private nonce)
• 11 SHAP values per decision (one per feature)
• negative shap → reduces default risk → GOOD
• positive shap → increases default risk → BAD
• Loaded in background thread (avoids 2.3s import delay)
• Shown to borrower as bar chart (top 8 factors)
Written by lender_admin · Read by gateway at startup
Append-only log · One JSON per line
Each line contains full signed record
Used by verifier and compliance UI
Merkle root = binary tree of SHA-256s
First request may lack SHAP if not loaded
Lender, Regulator, or Ombudsman runs this · No raw data needed · No cloud dependency · Offline capable
2. Reconstruct signed payload: strip signature + record_hash from record
4. ✅ PASS → record was created by registered gateway
❌ FAIL → record was not signed by known gateway (forgery or key mismatch)
1. Reconstruct signed payload (same as above — exclude sig + record_hash)
4. ✅ PASS → no field in the record has been modified
❌ FAIL → any field (decision, score, timestamp) was altered post-signing
1. Find batch in merkle_witness.jsonl containing record['record_hash']
2. Get batch leaves[] and published merkle_root
3. Recompute root from leaves (binary SHA-256 tree)
4. ✅ PASS → computed root = published root → record was in original batch
⚠️ WARN → record not yet in any batch (too recent, pending flush)
🔐 ZERO-KNOWLEDGE PROOF SYSTEM — EZKL Halo2 SNARK
Proves computation without revealing model weights or applicant data · Trust anchor: open mathematics, no cloud vendor
5. Circuit encodes: model weights as constants
3. Run model forward pass inside ZK circuit
Private: feature_vec, nonce | Public: commitment, prob_output
5. ✅ TRUE → proven model produced this output
6. No internet, no cloud, no vendor trust needed
ZK vs TEE — Why ZK Wins Here
TEE (AWS Nitro): attestation signed by Amazon AWS
→ Certificate format differs per cloud (no portability)
→ Verify offline, any machine, no vendor
→ Self-contained: verifiable in 2035 with same vk.key
